name: warrior 10 -> 30 (meowdb leveling guide)
_about: Follows plans/maple-island-to-perion.json (ends at Dances with Balrog). Run with --build builds/warrior.json so AP/SP follow the guide and Power Strike / Slash Blast go on Shift / Del. Training maps and quests are the guide's; resupply buys Red Potions from Luna (row 0, verified). Gear purchases have empty buy lists until the weapon store rows are read off a screenshot (see docs/warrior-10-30.md).

steps._note: Dances with Balrog: first job advancement to Warrior (needs level 10).
Perion Street Corner (Stumps, Dark Stumps, snails): to level 11 for Blackbull's quest.
No resupply here: a shop trip sells the etc tab, which holds the quest items.
Pays 380 mesos and a Wooden Buckler (90%) or Steel Shield (10%).

steps._buy: Guide, level 10: Long Sword, Wooden Sword or Metal Axe (River). Put its list row in buy, e.g. [{"slot": N, "qty": 1}], then the equip step below puts it on.

steps._note: Perion -> Henesys. Every route passes level-25 mobs (Rocky Road); the router takes the least dangerous one.
The Rain-Forest East of Henesys (Pig, Ribbon Pig), the guide's level 10-14 map.

steps._buy: Guide, level 15: Sabre or Battle Axe, Steel Fitted Mail (River / Harry in Perion).

steps._note: Rain-Forest East again for 15-19 (the guide's best rate there).

steps._buy: Guide, level 20: Viking Sword, Two-Handed Sword or Iron Axe; Red Kendo Robe.

steps._note: Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North IV (Slime, Green Mushroom), level 20-24.
Hand the gem to Utah (Utah's Pig Farm): 775 mesos, 2,750 EXP.

steps._buy: Guide, level 25: Mithril Axe, Broadsword or Two-Handed Axe (River).

steps._note: Level 30: back to Dances with Balrog for the second job (not automated).
